about: CIE Automotive India Limited produces and sells automotive components to original equipment manufacturers and other customers in India, Europe, and internationally. It offers forgings, such as crankshafts, CV joints, knuckles, diff Casw, and spindles; gears, including gears and shafts, e-drive components, flanges/end yokes, and clutch hubs; composites comprising front lid, wind shield-electric-3WH, electric box top tray, and front bumper; and crankcase, pump housing, and brake panel aluminum pro
